verdicts.reason: A squeezes the full four-line headline against the top edge, adds an unreadably small body-copy block on the right, and shrinks the badges to illegible slivers. The CTA is a small button in the middle, the product can is gone and there is no visible logo, so it reads as a cramped, shrunk copy. B is cleaner, with a three-line headline that is roughly legible, but the 'LIMITED EDITION' badge is bigger and louder than the tiny CTA crammed into the top-right corner. B also drops the product, the left-hand logo marks are microscopic, and fine-print fragments are scattered around, so neither could ship.
